title: Калькулятор (переменные)
semantics: Create ordered integer/real/string/boolean variables without a table or required input. Constants or native expressions; Expr.name can refer to an earlier expression. Preserve typed NULL separately from empty string, false and zero. Output variables port 0; Execute evaluates current values, with no training model. Optional upstream variables depend on W1. Reject datetime, variant, JavaScript, intermediate/replacement/cache controls in stage 1. Integer acceptance is restricted to safe IEEE754 integer values; never claim exactness beyond the reader contract.

parameter_schema.description: Create or update scalar variables; stage 1 excludes intermediate, replacement, cache and reorder controls.

expressions.description: 1–32 ordered changes. New requires all name/label/type/formula fields; new node replaces the blank Expr1. Patches preserve unlisted expressions and their order.

items.description: Ordered scalar expression patch; unlisted saved expressions stay unchanged.

target.description: Choose one new or existing expression.

kind.description: new adds a variable; existing patches one saved expression.

name.description: Exact saved expression name; required only for existing.
Technical output name. Required for new; existing omission preserves it.

label.description: Display label independent of name. Required for new; omission preserves existing.

type.description: Output type; no inference. Required for new; omission preserves existing.

formula.description: Native Loginom expression, not JavaScript. Quotes for strings, TRUE/FALSE, NULL; Expr.name refers to an earlier expression. Required for new; omission preserves existing.

description.description: Optional expression description; omission preserves existing.
